messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered for customer 'orchard' in vpc-dedicated-us-west2. Severity: P1. Symptom: KV/prefix cache hit-rate collapse -> massive evictions + request tail latency. Affected pool: pool-22. Root ts=2205001234

jordan.sre: on-call here, seeing the alert. taking ownership. looking at cache metrics now.

ajay.mlinfra: jump in. basic numbers: orchard prefix hit-rate dropped from ~92% to 6% over the last 12m. eviction rate spiked x20. KV mem pressure up, prefetch threads saturated.

emily.platform: logs show prefetch workers thrashing: `prefetch_worker[orchard]` cycle errors 503 -> backing off not working. also seeing cross-tenant eviction noise in same pool.

jordan.sre: confirmed customer-visible 503s and tail latency increases. routing shows 30% of orchard requests hitting fallback path. impact: degraded API for Orchard billing flows.

maria.cs: Orchard CS here. They're reporting user-facing failed payments. They've stopped new campaigns but want ETA. I'm keeping them updated. Please prioritize.

ajay.mlinfra: quick mitigation options: 1) disable prefetch for orchard, 2) apply per-tenant cache quota, 3) tombstone heavy prefixes, 4) route orchard to a warmed reserve pool. Prefer 1+2 now.

emily.platform: I can disable prefetch immediately via control plane. Command: ```
# disable prefetch for tenant orchard
rwctl tenant update --tenant orchard --kv-prefetch enabled=false
```

jordan.sre: do it. and add short note in thread when done. I'll prepare rollout for per-tenant quota.

emily.platform: running disable now...

incident-bot: action executed: `rwctl tenant update --tenant orchard --kv-prefetch enabled=false` (initiated by emily.platform) at 2205001251

emily.platform: prefetch disabled. monitoring latency/hitrate.

ajay.mlinfra: already seeing small improvement in hit-rate (6% -> 22%) within 60s. eviction bursts down ~40%. good sign.

jordan.sre: prepping per-tenant cache quota change. plan: set orchard cache max to 12GB (was no cap). applying as hot config.

emily.platform: applying quota... ```
rwctl tenant update --tenant orchard --kv-quota 12GB
```

incident-bot: action executed: `rwctl tenant update --tenant orchard --kv-quota 12GB` (initiated by emily.platform) at 2205001264

ajay.mlinfra: quota applied. eviction rate stabilized further. hit-rate climbing to ~48% now. tail latency for orchard dropping toward baseline but still noisy.

maria.cs: relayed to customer: "we've disabled prefetch and limited your cache usage to stabilize the system. we're seeing improvements and will follow up with RCA." They asked if we can route traffic away from that pool until full mitigation.

jordan.sre: short-term routing: we can drain new sessions for orchard to backup pool-18 (lower capacity) with auto-fallback. emily, can you initiate a controlled drain? We should avoid complete cutover to not lose warm cache.

emily.platform: initiating drain + slow-ramp to pool-18. command: ```
rwctl route update --tenant orchard --preferred-pool pool-18 --drain-secs 300
```

incident-bot: action executed: `rwctl route update --tenant orchard --preferred-pool pool-18 --drain-secs 300` (initiated by emily.platform) at 2205001278

ajay.mlinfra: note: pool-18 currently has available headroom for limited traffic. routing will reduce pressure on pool-22 and help KV warm-up on pool-18. Keep throttle at 20% ramp.

jordan.sre: putting an incident note: temporary mitigations = prefetch disabled, 12GB quota, slow-routed to pool-18. Next steps: collect heap/kv profiles, identify offending prefix patterns (likely a new Orchard feature rollout with high cardinality prefixes), add rate-limits on writes.

samir.sdr: I spoke with Orchard engineering. They confirm a feature rollout this morning that fires many ad-hoc prefixes for large user cohorts. They agree to hold rollout and throttle clients. They're open to postmortem coordination.

maria.cs: Orchard requests timeline for full recovery and RCA. ETA for stable service?

ajay.mlinfra: if current trend holds, we should get orchard baseline latency within 20-30m after full warm-up on pool-18. RCA and mitigation plan within 24h.

emily.platform: monitoring dashboards: `kv.hitrate`, `kv.evictions`, `prefetch.worker_errors`, `pool.utilization`. Linking snapshots. (link omitted)

jordan.sre: handoff note for next on-call: Jordan -> Ajay in 40m (shift change). Ajay will own follow-ups and RCA. I'll remain as responder for customer comms until stable.

ajay.mlinfra: taking over on-call at 2205001290. I'll keep watching and open a followup thread for the postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager duty reminder. Next check-in scheduled in 15m.

maria.cs: thanks team. I told Orchard we're in mitigation and we'll provide a detailed RCA + follow-up meeting in 24h. They've asked for a postmortem invite window: prefer tomorrow 1300 PST.

jordan.sre: noted. adding calendar invite. final status (so far): mitigations applied, customer impact reduced, monitoring continues. Closing P1 to P2 in 45m if stable. (:+1:)

ajay.mlinfra: logs excerpt for RCA: ```
[2205001230] tenant=orchard prefix=/campaigns/exp-.* hits=2 misses=198 eviction=3200
[2205001240] prefetch_pool: worker_loop error backoff exhausted count=87
[2205001250] route: redirecting 18%->pool-18
```

emily.platform: saving runbook entry: "orchard prefix bloomstorm" - steps: disable prefetch, apply per-tenant quota, route to reserve pool, coordinate customer rollout rollback.

samir.sdr: Orchard appreciates the quick action. asking for contact list for postmortem. I'll share our follow-up notes to them.

jordan.sre: closing notes: ensure runbook update, assign postmortem owner (ajay.mlinfra), include telemetry and sample prefixes, and consider adding automatic tenant-prefetch circuit breaker for unusually high prefix cardinality.

ajay.mlinfra: acknowledged. will open postmortem doc and ping infra/research for kernel/runtime analysis.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived for indexing at 2205001298
